claims.claim: Rust for Linux provides infrastructure for writing selected Linux kernel components in Rust; supported abstractions evolve over time.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Availability depends on kernel release, configuration and subsystem support.

claims.claim: seL4 is a formally verified microkernel with published proof and system documentation.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Formal guarantees apply to specified models, configurations and assumptions.

claims.claim: RISC-V is an open standard instruction set architecture with a growing operating-system ecosystem.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: ISA openness does not imply every implementation or platform is equivalent.

claims.claim: Confidential computing technologies such as AMD SEV-SNP and Intel TDX aim to protect guest workloads from some host-level threats.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Threat models, attestation, firmware and I/O paths impose important limitations.

claims.claim: Rust for Linux 的内核支持自 Linux 6.1 起进入主线；具体 Rust API、工具链版本和驱动使用者需按目标内核分支核验。
claims.notes: 主线支持不代表所有发行版内核都启用 Rust。

claims.claim: AMD SEV-SNP 与 Intel TDX 为机密虚拟机提供不同的硬件隔离与 attestation 机制；保护范围和平台要求不同，不能概括为 Hypervisor 完全无法观察所有 VM 元数据或 I/O。
claims.notes: 需结合 AMD/Intel 平台安全模型与云厂商部署文档。

claims.claim: PCIe IDE 是链路级数据保护机制，需要链路两端与平台密钥管理支持；不等于所有 DMA 流量自动加密或所有设备默认支持。
claims.notes: 实际部署应核对 PCIe IDE capable endpoint/root port 和平台固件。

claims.claim: Confidential Containers 通常基于 confidential VM 与 attestation/key broker 组件构建 Pod 级信任链；不是每个容器天然拥有独立硬件隔离环境。
claims.notes: runtime、TEE 类型和 key broker 方案决定具体信任边界。
